  S.add(new THREE.Points(sg,new THREE.PointsMaterial({color:0xeae6da,size:.18,sizeAttenuation:true})));
  function ring(rad,col,op){var p=[];for(var k=0;k<=128;k++){var t=k/128*6.283;p.push(Math.cos(t)*rad,0,Math.sin(t)*rad);}
    var g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(p,3));
    return new THREE.Line(g,new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:col,transparent:true,opacity:op}));}
  function sat(){var g=new THREE.Group();
    var m=new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({color:0xd9c9a3,shininess:60}),pm=new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({color:0x1d3b6b,emissive:0x0a1a33,shininess:90});
    g.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.28,.28,.4),m));
    [-1,1].forEach(function(s){var p=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.7,.02,.3),pm);p.position.x=s*.52;g.add(p);
      var a=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.015,.015,.24,6),m);a.rotation.z=Math.PI/2;a.position.x=s*.2;g.add(a);});
    var d=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.12,16,8,0,6.283,0,1.4),m);d.position.z=.26;d.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;g.add(d);
    g.scale.setScalar(.75);return g;}
  var orbits=[{r:3.7,tilt:.6,sp:.35,c:0x8fae56},{r:4.6,tilt:-.9,sp:.22,c:0xc9793f}].map(function(o,n){
    var pivot=new THREE.Group();pivot.rotation.x=o.tilt;pivot.rotation.z=n?.5:-.3;G.add(pivot);
    pivot.add(ring(o.r,o.c,.45));var s=sat();pivot.add(s);o.s=s;o.ph=n*2;return o;});
  function size(){var w=innerWidth,h=innerHeight;R.setSize(w,h,false);C.aspect=w/h;C.updateProjectionMatrix();
    G.position.x=w>900?2.6:0; G.position.y=w>900?0:1.2; G.scale.setScalar(w>900?1:.8);}
  addEventListener('resize',size); size();
  var reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  (function loop(t){requestAnimationFrame(loop);var k=reduce?0:t*.001;
    earth.rotation.y=k*.08;
    orbits.forEach(function(o){var a=o.ph+k*o.sp;o.s.position.set(Math.cos(a)*o.r,0,Math.sin(a)*o.r);o.s.rotation.y=-a;});
    C.position.x=Math.sin(k*.1)*.5; C.lookAt(0,0,0); R.render(S,C);})(0);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  var box=document.getElementById('tagline'); if(!box) return;
  var ghost=box.querySelector('.tw-ghost'), live=box.querySelector('.tw-live');
  if(matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){return;}
  box.classList.add('tw-on');
  // clone structure (keeps the green <em> highlight), then empty every text node
  var nodes=[]; 
  ghost.childNodes.forEach(function(n){
    var c=n.cloneNode(true); live.appendChild(c);
    if(c.nodeType===3){nodes.push({el:c,txt:c.textContent}); c.textContent='';}
    else{var t=c.firstChild; nodes.push({el:t,txt:t.textContent}); t.textContent='';}
  });
  live.classList.add('typing');
  var i=0,j=0;
  function tick(){
    if(i>=nodes.length){live.classList.remove('typing'); live.classList.add('done'); return;}
    var n=nodes[i]; j++; n.el.textContent=n.txt.slice(0,j);
    if(j>=n.txt.length){i++; j=0;}
    var ch=n.txt.charAt(j-1), d=38+Math.random()*45;
    if(/[,&]/.test(ch)) d+=180;
    setTimeout(tick,d);
  }
  setTimeout(tick,900);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  var card = document.getElementById('profileFlip');
  if(!card) return;

  function toggleFlip(){
    card.classList.toggle('flipped');
  }

  card.addEventListener('click', toggleFlip);

  card.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if(e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' '){
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleFlip();
    }
  });

  /* Subtle mouse-driven 3D depth */
  card.addEventListener('pointermove', function(e){
    if(window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;

    var rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
    var x = (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width - 0.5;
    var y = (e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height - 0.5;

    var rx = (-y * 5).toFixed(2);
    var ry = (x * 7).toFixed(2);

    if(card.classList.contains('flipped')){
      card.querySelector('.photo-flip').style.transform =
        'rotateY(180deg) rotateX(' + rx + 'deg) rotateY(' + (-ry) + 'deg) translateZ(5px)';
    } else {
      card.querySelector('.photo-flip').style.transform =
        'rotateX(' + rx + 'deg) rotateY(' + ry + 'deg) translateZ(5px)';
    }
  });

  card.addEventListener('pointerleave', function(){
    var flip = card.querySelector('.photo-flip');
    flip.style.transform = card.classList.contains('flipped')
      ? 'rotateY(180deg) translateZ(2px)'
      : 'translateZ(0)';
  });
})();
</script>

</body>
